question: Does a simpler output-focused fidelity contract improve overall subject extraction compared with ASv6.13, while retaining the same coverage and evidence requirements?
baseline_reason: ASv6.13 has two full-development runs and outperformed ASv6.17 in the fresh paired run. ASv6.18's metadata improvement did not establish a better overall replacement. ASv6.13 is a failing but evidence-backed comparison, not a frozen winner.
changes: Move the standalone-item outcome near the goal and state that necessary event/topic/numerical context comes from the complete post.
Replace the warning about source gaps with a direct description of valid output, retaining the content-versus-presentation sentence.
Simplify numeric fidelity wording without the count/measurement or label-pair instructions that appeared in flawed outputs.
State attribution preservation conditionally when an item attributes a statement; do not require adding attribution to every subject.
unchanged: Literal, nonliteral and rhetorical coverage, whole-post and multi-part meanings, broad/narrow/overlapping/nested subjects, source evidence outside URLs, general-knowledge limits, supported alternative interpretations, relationship/negation/comparison fidelity and meaning before brevity. Same Sol low, pinned binary and runner, normalization and schema.
design: All 28 frozen development notes, one fresh output from each unchanged version, 56 sequential calls. Odd note positions run ASv6.13 then ASv6.19; even positions reverse the order. Review every output against the complete note and use the same standards for both versions.
interpretation: This tests the revised instruction group as a whole; it cannot attribute an effect to one individual sentence. Review concrete gains and regressions across the complete development set, not only the CEO, insurance or fee notes. A gain limited to a few probes is not an overall win. Repeat inconclusive comparisons rather than automatically retaining the new version. All fixed development gates and repeated-note checks still precede untouched final validation.

audit.why_test: The guide supports simplifying repeated/process instructions and checking representative tasks. The suspected source-gap instruction echo and numeric field-copying are evidence for this comparison, not proof the revision will work.
